notes.text: English: This continuation first proposes injectivity of the local-to-global homomorphism and its geometric part. The later oblique note explicitly qualifies the proposal: “C'est visiblement faux” and the inserted “en général”, with card I(x) ≠ 1 and a change of model by blowing up a point of D. It then asks whether a “minimal” model has injectivity. These are source assertions and questions; I have not independently verified a theorem or counterexample.

English: Item 2 assumes that the residue field of V is algebraic over K. The compressed word before the zero-dimensional-point description remains correspondant|convergent, with a following à|: doubt after the independent reading. The source revises injectivity/surjectivity wording toward an open-image assertion; the first raised phrase literally begins une image, without a written a. The geometric map I_V → I_x = T^{I(x)} is treated similarly. The later dark conclusion says “sans doute est-elle = surjective.” The lexical = is retained. These remain source statements and conjectures; no proof check was performed.

English: The left marginal note explicitly warns that the two letters I are not the same. The diagram keeps the vertical pair of equality strokes under its left object; this is not a downward arrow. No drawings distinct from this diagram occur on the page.

English: The small 129 at the lower left is separate foliation, retained as a margin note rather than asserted to be the author's own pagination. The line_count of 20 counts the principal text/display baselines, excluding marginal and interlinear additions. All agreed words were read on the supplied halves. Crops P04 and P05 are clockwise-deskewed views of their recorded original-image boxes; P08 was retargeted before a reading was decided. No OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used.

Independent image-only audit: the en général stroke is an insertion leader, not a separate underline; the first raised image phrase has no written initial a; and the apparent dash before the old bottom explanation belongs to the cancelling line. The compressed correspondant/convergent word, à/colon mark, and several crossed predicates now carry local doubts. The original first and second TSVs remain unchanged; every difference is documented in second/149_scan130_adjudicated.tsv. No mathematical conclusion was used to supply these letters.
